original_question: Let G be a nonabelian group of order p^3. Does G have the weak local lifting property, meaning that some faithful action G -> Aut_k k[[z]] lifts to an action G -> Aut_R R[[Z]] for a discrete valuation ring R finite over W(k)?
target_in_paper: §7.3, Question 7.3 ("Inverse Galois local lifting problem for p-groups"), interpreted via Definition 7.2 and the ambient setup in §§7.1-7.2.
correct_elements: Your draft is already very close to the paper's exact target. It correctly singles out nonabelian groups of order p^3, correctly asks about the weak local lifting property rather than the stronger local lifting property for all actions, and correctly formulates that property as the existence of some faithful local action on k[[z]] lifting to an action on R[[Z]] for a DVR finite over W(k).
missing_details: The paper fixes k to be an algebraically closed field of characteristic p>0 before posing the question (§7.1).
To make the question stand-alone, p should be named explicitly as a prime, even though this is implicit in the phrase "group of order p^3" (§7.1, §7.3).

The weak local lifting property is given formally in Definition 7.2: there must exist a faithful homomorphism i: G -> Aut_k(k[[z]]) and a homomorphism G -> Aut_R(R[[Z]]) whose reduction modulo the maximal ideal of R recovers i (§7.3, Definition 7.2).
The automorphism groups are specifically Aut_k(k[[z]]) and Aut_R(R[[Z]]), i.e. automorphisms of formal power series rings over k and R, not arbitrary abstract actions (§§7.2-7.3).
For full self-containment, W(k) should be identified as the Witt ring of k.

The paper frames this as part of the "inverse Galois local lifting problem for p-groups," i.e. an existence question for at least one faithful local G-action, not a universal lifting statement for every such action (§7.3).
refined_question: Let p be a prime, let k be an algebraically closed field of characteristic p>0, and let G be a nonabelian group of order p^3. Does G have the weak local lifting property in the sense of Definition 7.2; that is, does there exist a discrete valuation ring R finite over the Witt ring W(k), a faithful homomorphism i: G -> Aut_k(k[[z]]), and a homomorphism \tilde{i}: G -> Aut_R(R[[Z]]) whose reduction modulo the maximal ideal of R is i?
justification: The draft is aimed at the exact official question posed in the paper. Section 7.1 sets the ambient hypotheses k algebraically closed of characteristic p>0 and discusses finite p-groups acting on k[[z]]. Section 7.2 defines the local lifting problem for a given action G -> Aut_k(k[[z]]) over a DVR finite over W(k). Section 7.3 then introduces the weak local lifting property in Definition 7.2 by requiring the existence of at least one faithful local action with such a lift, and Question 7.3 asks exactly whether a nonabelian group of order p^3 has this property. So the only needed refinements are to restore the ambient field hypothesis, make the reduction-compatibility explicit, and identify W(k).
